name: bellows-embedded
description: Header-only C++ port of the bellows DSP core for 32-bit microcontrollers. Not published to npm; distributed through the Arduino Library Manager and PlatformIO registry.

scripts.fastmath: mkdir -p test/parity/build && c++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -DBELLOWS_FAST_MATH=1 -I src test/parity/fastmath_test.cpp -o test/parity/build/fastmath && test/parity/build/fastmath
scripts.memsafety: mkdir -p test/safety/build && c++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I src test/safety/memsafety.cpp -o test/safety/build/memsafety && test/safety/build/memsafety
scripts.memsafety:fastmath: mkdir -p test/safety/build && c++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -DBELLOWS_FAST_MATH=1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I src test/safety/memsafety.cpp -o test/safety/build/memsafety_fm && test/safety/build/memsafety_fm
